message.Title: Generally Available: Azure Premium SSD v2 Disk is now available in Austria East and in a second Availability Zone in Japan West

Body.Content:
Azure Premium SSD v2 is now available in Austria East and in a second Availability Zone in Japan West.  

Azure Premium SSD v2, a next-generation general-purpose block storage solution, offers sub-millisecond latencies and exceptional price performance for IO-intensive workloads at a low cost. Premium SSD v2 is suited for a broad range of enterprise production scenarios, including SQL Server, Oracle, MariaDB, SAP, Cassandra, MongoDB, big data/analytics, and gaming on virtual machines or stateful containers.   

If Premium SSD v2 is unavailable in your preferred region and you would like to use it, please complete this survey.   

Learn more:   

  • Read the documentation.  

  • For more information about Premium SSD v2 Disk Storage pricing, visit the Azure Managed Disks pricing page.
